question: Find the oldest driver (by date of birth) who completed more than 50 laps in any race held between 2005 and 2010. Then, return their forename, surname, and the fastest first-lap time they recorded in any race during those years, expressed in milliseconds.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driverId
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON ra.XCL_065 = r.XCL_074
  WHERE ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2010
    AND r.XCL_083 > 50
  GROUP BY r.XCL_075
),
oldest AS (
  SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driverId
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN eligible e ON e.driverId = d.XCL_034
  ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038 AS forename,
       d.XCL_039 AS surname,
       (SELECT MIN(lt.XCL_048)
        FROM lapTimes lt
        JOIN races ra2 ON ra2.XCL_065 = lt.XCL_043
        WHERE lt.XCL_044 = o.driverId
          AND lt.XCL_045 = 1
          AND ra2.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2010
       ) AS fastest_first_lap_ms
FROM oldest o
JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = o.driverId
